description: Consommation annuelle finale régionale d'électricité (2006 à 2024) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Consommation finale (hors pertes) annuelle d'électricité (GWh), corrigée de l'aléa climatique, par région administrative.. Les consommations sont au statut définitif jusque l'année 2024. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are Bilan annuel. The portal shows 2025-11-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
